maturity_rule: an empty object schema (no properties AND no required) is one whole-schema OPEN CUSTOMER SEAM ("(schema)"); otherwise top-level walk of schema.properties: a property whose definition has no typed shape (no non-empty properties/required) and no type constraint beyond object/untyped is an OPEN CUSTOMER SEAM (deliberate payload leniency, blocker2); >=1 seam => open_customer_seam, else platform_complete. domain_complete is never factory-emitted (only the customer can attest it).
